summary: Iteration 5 backend testing found TWO CRITICAL bugs blocking the feature. Frontend UI is largely wired correctly (badges render, Sisa text shows) but has ONE display bug (Total PO shows 0 in dialog). Backend: 5/11 pass, 6/11 fail. Root cause: create_po and create_staffing were never updated to handle qty_staffed — only update_po and update_staffing were touched.

critical.issue: create_po does NOT initialize qty_staffed=0 in items_with_details. Only update_po (line 456+) sets it. Newly-created POs are missing the field entirely.

create_staffing does NOT increment po.items[].qty_staffed. Only update_staffing/delete_staffing were wired. As a result: creating a fresh staffing leaves qty_staffed=0 on the PO, and the Rekap 'Komplit Terkirim' badge and Staffing dialog 'Sisa' logic never advance for any newly-created staffing. The spec explicitly requires this.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog shows 'Total PO: 0' instead of the actual PO qty. Root cause: selectPO() spreads {...i, qty: 0} — overwriting item.qty with the input value 0 — so the '{item.qty}' interpolation on line 161 renders 0. Should either preserve original qty as _original_qty (or _sisa + qty_staffed) or reference it separately.

integration_issues.issue: Because create_staffing doesn't increment qty_staffed, new staffing entries never make komplit_terkirim=True. UI badges render correctly given the data — the bug is upstream in the API.

verified_working: N10036 shows 'Komplit SPK' blue badge on both rows in Rekap PO tab (verified via UI + API)
Rekap /api/rekap/all-po returns komplit_spk/komplit_terkirim/komplit_pengrajin/ready boolean fields on every row
Staffing dialog renders 'Total PO: X • Sudah dikirim: Y • Sisa: Z' text (Sisa & Sudah dikirim values correct; Total PO shows 0 - bug above)
Staffing qty input capped at _max_qty (verified 'Qty (max 20)' label on N10036 Kopitiam Stool)
update_staffing reverts old and applies new qty_staffed (behavior verified through the delta observed in the test)
delete_staffing reverts qty_staffed and returns 404 if id not found
Rekap PO table has new Status column with 4 badge components + data-testids
Existing migration successfully backfilled qty_staffed on N10036/N10037 (Kopitiam Stool=30, napeleon=100)
action_items: FIX server.py create_po (line 388-399): add "qty_staffed": 0, alongside "qty_diterima": 0 in items_with_details.
FIX server.py create_staffing (line 540-560): after insert_one, loop through staffing.items and $inc po.items.$.qty_staffed by item.qty (mirror update_staffing lines 1214-1218).

FIX Staffing.jsx selectPO (line 43-46): keep original PO qty in a separate field (e.g., _original_qty = i.qty) and change line 161 to render '{item._original_qty || item.qty}'. Or drop qty:0 override and drive the input from a separate _input_qty field.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1608 lines — modularization still overdue (as flagged in iter4).
po_status() in get_rekap_all_po (line 840) is O(POs × items × spks × spk.items) — fine at current scale but consider $lookup aggregation when data grows.

update_po (line 456+) resets qty_staffed to 0 unconditionally on every PO edit — this may silently wipe out already-shipped staffing history bookkeeping if an admin edits a PO after staffing exists. Consider preserving existing qty_staffed values per barang_id on update.
create_staffing/update_staffing accept staffing.items as a raw list[dict] (no Pydantic validation of qty/barang_id inside each item). Add a StaffingItem model.
No index on progres.po_id or staffing.po_id — po_status() loads full collections into memory.

Also do quick UI check: open Staffing dialog on N10036, verify 'Total PO: 50' (not 0). N10036 existing test data is intact and shows Komplit SPK badge correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: The developer added qty_staffed handling to update_po, update_staffing, delete_staffing, and get_rekap_all_po but overlooked the two POST endpoints (create_po and create_staffing) — the two entry points that would establish the field in the first place. Frontend selectPO reuses the same 'qty' key for both the PO-original qty and the user-input qty, causing the Total PO label to display 0.
